conventions: Avoid structure_type class/function modify-by-name on any declaration whose signature has a brace before its real body (lambda default like = {}) -- DailyListScreen's own signature has this shape, so edits to it use structure_type block/constant with short verified-unique single-line anchors instead.
For change_type add, exact_code must contain ONLY the new content -- never repeat the anchor line itself, the runner inserts after the anchor automatically.

TimeInput/rememberTimePickerState (Material3, already available via this project's Compose BOM) are used with is24Hour = false to match the h:mm a format already used throughout the app (DoseRow, ReminderMessage).
